questions.question: What overall percentage of healthcare personnel were vaccinated against the flu at Alameda Hospital during the 2025-26 season?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_cdph_health_care_personnel_flu_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='HCP_FLU_BY_HOSP_CNTY')
row = df[df['Facility_Name'] == 'ALAMEDA HOSPITAL']
result = int(row['HCP_Percent_Vaccinated'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Which facility reported more total healthcare workers vaccinated during the 2025-26 influenza season, UCSF Medical Center or Keck Hospital of USC?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_cdph_health_care_personnel_flu_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='HCP_FLU_BY_HOSP_CNTY')
ucsf = df[df['Facility_Name'] == 'UCSF MEDICAL CENTER']['HCP_Total_Number_Vaccinated'].iloc[0]
keck = df[df['Facility_Name'] == 'KECK HOSPITAL OF USC']['HCP_Total_Number_Vaccinated'].iloc[0]
result = 'UCSF MEDICAL CENTER' if ucsf > keck else 'KECK HOSPITAL OF USC'

questions.question: Did Rady Children's Hospital - San Diego achieve at least a 90% overall healthcare personnel vaccination rate in the 2025-26 season?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_cdph_health_care_personnel_flu_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='HCP_FLU_BY_HOSP_CNTY')
val = df[df['Facility_Name'] == "RADY CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL - SAN DIEGO"]['HCP_Percent_Vaccinated'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if val >= 90 else 'no'
